# IBrains — AI Engineering Studio

> IBrains is a top-tier AI engineering studio specializing in conversational Voice AI Agents, Industrial IoT connected hardware, cross-platform Mobile Engineering, and EduFlex adaptive learning platforms.

## Core Engineering Services

- [Voice AI Agents](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#products): Natural-sounding conversational voice agents for inbound/outbound calls, candidate screening, real estate leads, medical booking, and automated support.
- [Industrial IoT Systems](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#products): Connected hardware, edge telemetry, and sensor integration linking physical assets to AI backend intelligence.
- [Mobile Applications](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#products): High-performance iOS and Android applications built with clean architecture and seamless UI/UX.
- [EduFlex EdTech Platform](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#products): An adaptive learning platform for schools and training providers that personalizes curriculum and tracks student mastery.
- [Resume Shortlisting Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Automated recruitment AI that parses resumes against exact Job Descriptions and skill requirements.

## Live Production AI Agents

- [HR Voice Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Voice screening, policy queries, and interview scheduling.
- [Resume Shortlisting Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): JD-to-resume matching and candidate shortlisting.
- [Technical Interviewer Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Voice-based technical screening with adaptive follow-ups.
- [Coding Round Interviewer Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Live technical coding round evaluation.
- [System Design Interview Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Architecture & system design evaluation.
- [Screen Tracker Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Real-time conversational screen-share analysis.
- [Real Estate Voice Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Property Q&A and lead qualification by voice.
- [CRM Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Automated call logging and CRM record updates.
- [Ortho Medical Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Medical clinic booking and patient triage.
- [Loan Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Voice-guided loan applications and eligibility checks.
- [Insurance Agent](https://ibrains.pages.dev/#agents): Policy inquiries, claims, and coverage updates.
